`enum ShaderBuiltin`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.shader.source` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ShaderBuiltin.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/shader/source/ShaderBuiltin.java)

The names that a JOID GLSL source uses without declaring them, the vertex attributes, the matrices and the lighting that JOID provides, and the fragment output.

## Description

A shader reads `aPosition` or writes `fragColor` without a declaration: [`ShaderSource`](/reference/pipeline/shadersource/) notes which built-in names each stage uses, and [`GlslShaderTranslator`](/reference/pipeline/glslshadertranslator/) declares those, plus `fragColor` in every fragment stage.
A declaration of a built-in name in the source is ignored.
The attributes take their location and their format from [`VertexAttribute`](/reference/pipeline/vertexattribute/); [`Shader.builtins`](/reference/bridges/shader/#Shader-method-builtins) writes the uniforms before each draw.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`POSITION`](#ShaderBuiltin-value-POSITION) | `vec3 aPosition`: the position of the vertex, in design pixels in a UI, before the model-view and projection matrices. |
| [`TEXTURE_COORDINATE`](#ShaderBuiltin-value-TEXTURE_COORDINATE) | `vec2 aTexCoord`: the texture coordinate of the vertex. |
| [`COLOR`](#ShaderBuiltin-value-COLOR) | `vec4 aColor`: the color of the vertex, or the current color of the render state for a buffer without colors. |
| [`NORMAL`](#ShaderBuiltin-value-NORMAL) | `vec3 aNormal`: the normal of the vertex, for lit 3D models. |
| [`PROJECTION_MATRIX`](#ShaderBuiltin-value-PROJECTION_MATRIX) | `mat4 uProjectionMatrix`: the projection of the render bridge. |
| [`MODEL_VIEW_MATRIX`](#ShaderBuiltin-value-MODEL_VIEW_MATRIX) | `mat4 uModelViewMatrix`: the model-view matrix of the render bridge. |
| [`NORMAL_MATRIX`](#ShaderBuiltin-value-NORMAL_MATRIX) | `mat3 uNormalMatrix`: the matrix that transforms the normals for the model-view matrix. |
| [`LIGHTING`](#ShaderBuiltin-value-LIGHTING) | `bool uLighting`: `true` while the render state has lighting on. |
| [`FRAGMENT_COLOR`](#ShaderBuiltin-value-FRAGMENT_COLOR) | `vec4 fragColor`: the color that the fragment stage writes. |
